summary: Broad-phase AABB overlap detection over a batch of triangles described by this[0] (count) and this[2] (triangle array, 32-byte stride). Allocates a temporary projection buffer (20 bytes per entry) with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, builds axis-aligned min/max projections for each triangle from its three vertex float pointers, sorts the entries by left bound via sub_5890AA with the sub_448440 comparator, then sweeps overlapping windows and validates each candidate pair with SATEdgeSeparationTest, marking overlapping triangle pairs with a 1 byte at triangle+24. Frees the buffer with FreeWrapper_7bcf and returns the triangle count. Invoked by CollisionGeometryOperationSelector as the broad phase before narrow-phase processing.

local_names.this: collision batch header (this[0] count, this[2] triangle array pointer)
local_names.v3: byte offset into the triangle array (stride 32)
local_names.v4: current AABB projection entry pointer (stride 5 floats)
local_names.v6: first vertex float pointer of the triangle
local_names.v7: second vertex float pointer of the triangle
local_names.v8: third vertex float pointer of the triangle

operations.description: Allocate the projection buffer: v2 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(20 * *this), sizing 20 bytes per triangle entry from the batch count at this+0x0
Guard on the batch count: when *this <= 0 skip the AABB-build loop, sort and sweep entirely (buffer remains NULL-allocated and only the count is returned)

Build projection entries for each triangle (v3 stepping by 32 through the triangle array at this+0x8): read the three vertex float pointers at triangle+0, +8 and +16, clear the overlap flag byte at triangle+24 to 0, store the triangle pointer, then compute the min and max of the axis floats (*v6, *v7, *v8) and of the second coordinate floats (v6[3], v7[3], v8[3]) into the 5-float entry
Sort the projection array: sub_5890AA(v2, *v1, 20, sub_448440) orders entries by their left bound using the sub_448440 comparator callback

Sweep for overlaps: for each pivot entry, scan forward while the candidate left bound stays within the pivot right bound (breaking once *(v18-2) > v23); on x-overlap (v17[2] > *v18 && v17[1] < v18[1]) run SATEdgeSeparationTest on the two triangles and, when it returns non-zero, set the overlap flag byte at both triangle+24 to 1
Free the temporary projection buffer with FreeWrapper_7bcf(v2) when it is non-null; the return value of the free becomes the function result
Return the triangle count (result = *this) when the buffer was never allocated, otherwise the FreeWrapper_7bcf result
Invoked by CollisionGeometryOperationSelector (0044BB60) to find overlapping triangle pairs before narrow-phase collision resolution
